en.d: A participant on the track — a man going through the TOP for the first time.
A graduated member of the movement; also the title conferred at graduation.
The squad a Traveler is assigned to, led by a captain and a vice-captain.
The team that directs, commands and paces the Travelers throughout the track.
The support and care team looking after the Travelers' physical and medical wellbeing.
Also called Venting. A guided sharing circle where the men open up and give testimony.
A fixed teaching stop along the route, numbered in sequence.
The physical confrontation challenge on Day 3.
Safety inspection of personal belongings; two are scheduled on Day 1.
Meal Ready to Eat — the field ration issued before the night march.
The celebration meal served to the new Legendaries after graduation.
